newsitem.title: UK: Scottish & Newcastle down as Merrill trims.
newsitem.headline: Scottish & Newcastle down as Merrill trims.

text.p: Shares in Scottish & Newcastle Plc dipped on Wednesday as analysts at Merrill Lynch trimmed earnings estimates for the brewing, leisure and restaurants group, traders said.
The stock was down 3p at 638 by 0906 GMT, after earlier dropping to 635p -- its lowest since early August.
Market sources said Merrill lowered its 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates by three percent to 44.2p per share and 49.5p respectively.

It attributed the change to expected higher discounts to tenants of its Inntrepreneur Estates pubs business ahead of the ending of supply agreements in 1998, and to continued difficult trading in the Centre Parcs unit, market sources said.
Analysts at the brokerage, which has a "neutral" rating on the stock, were not immediately available for comment.
